10th at Birch Intersection Improvements

Project Information

The 10th Avenue at Birch Street intersection improvements project aims to improve safety around the Birch Elementary School. The primary objective of this project is to improve pedestrian safety and accessibility. Project improvements include concrete sidewalk and ADA accessible curb ramps, storm drainage improvements, asphalt resurfacing, signage and striping. Curb extensions (i.e. neckdowns) are proposed at each quadrant to shorten the crossing distances and enhance visibility of pedestrians. In addition, parking will be removed along the south side of 10th Avenue, and wider sidewalks will be constructed along both sides of 10th Avenue, between Birch Street and Cottonwood Street. The project design is based on findings from the Existing Conditions and Recommendations Report, which summarizes the current conditions, identifies safety concerns, and outlines the recommended improvements. 

Timeline

  • Final Design: May - September 2026
  • Utility Coordination and Relocation: July 2026 - April 2027

  • Winter 2026: The budget, scope, prioritization and timing of the project are being re-evaluated due to the planned closure of Birch Elementary School.
